Negotiate vendor data processing agreements. Deliver compliance sign-off by June 2026. Priority: Medium. Compliance review depends on vendor selection (CTO) -- data processing agreements cannot be finalized until vendor is selected.

Pilot success metrics review: At pilot completion, validate that data integrity exceeds 99.99%, system performance meets or exceeds baseline, and per-unit costs align within 10% of projections.
GUARDRAIL_ACTIONS: Vendor exit clause: CTO must validate that contractual exit clause limits switching costs to 15% of annual spend before contract execution. If vendor cannot meet this threshold, escalate to CEO for re-evaluation. Data rollback capability: Operations must maintain full rollback capability for 90 days post-migration for each deployment phase. Rollback procedures must be tested before each phase begins.
